newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS UNCHANGED AT 1,590-1,600 TO DLR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS UNCHANGED AT 1,590-1,600 TO DLR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,590-1,600 per dollar, unchanged from morning levels and from Tuesday's close as the central bank was again seen as the main dollar buyer in the interbank market, dealers said.
"Final clients offered dollars but demand was generally low. Only central bank purchases prevented the lev from rising from opening levels and locked trade in a narrow range," said a bank dealer.

The lev/dollar exchange rate was assumed at an average of 2,000 from March through June in the memorandum of economic policies, agreed between the interim government and the International Monetary Fund last week.

Under a financial accord with the IMF Bulgaria is expected to introduce in June a tough fixed exchange rate mechanism, the currency board system, to restore confidence in the lev. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
